const int MOD = 1e9+7;
long long powerMod(long long a, long long b, long long mod) {
    long long res = 1, base = a;
    while(b) {
        if(b & 1) res = res * base % mod;
        base = base * base % mod;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

        ans = powerMod(p, p-1, MOD);
        printf("%d\n", ans);

            seq.push_back(j);
            j = (long long)j * k % p;
        }
        int d = seq.size();
        if(powerMod(k, d, p) == 1)
            ans = (long long)ans * p % MOD;
        seq.clear();
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
#ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
